name: Ideogram 4.5 Edit Image
description: Ideogram 4.5 editing from up to five images with an optional mask, priced per image by quality.

num_images.description: Images to return. Each one is billed.
num_images.title: Num Images

image_urls.description: The first image is the one edited; the rest are references. At most 4 with a mask.
image_urls.title: Image Urls

mask_image_url.description: Same pixel size as the first image. Black is edited, white is kept; it must contain both.
mask_image_url.title: Mask Image Url

quality.description: "high" picks the best of several candidates, so it takes longer.
quality.title: Quality

size.description: "auto", "source" (keep the first image's shape), or WIDTHxHEIGHT in multiples of 32, each at least 256, at most 4,194,304 pixels and 6:1. Omitted, Ideogram picks. Not accepted with a mask.
size.title: Size
